offer.text: Rain's the best time to plant! Quick, gather me 16 seeds while the soil's soft.

accept.text: Hurry now — a good shower won't wait for slow hands.

decline.text: The rain will pass and the chance with it.

in_progress.text: Got those seeds while it's still wet?

ready.text: Sixteen seeds, ready for the drills. The fields will thank you.

complete.text: Planted in the rain, harvested in the sun. That's farming.
